response.evidence: First, Push your code to a public or private GitHub repository. Second, Sign in on Deno Deploy with your GitHub account, and click on New Project. Third, Select your repository, the branch you want to deploy from, and select GitHub Action mode.
response.rationale: The artifact instructs pushing your code to a GitHub repository in the first step, and then in the third step says to 'Select your repository' when setting up the Deno Deploy project. The phrase 'your repository' refers back to the repository the code was pushed to, so the selected repository is the one you pushed your code to at the start of the route. The artifact does not state this identification verbatim, so the support is inferred from the sequence of steps.
